rows.ARS:
Medium pink Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: MACauclad
Exhibition name: Kathryn McGredy
rows.Origin:
Bred by Samuel Darragh (1932-2019) McGredy IV (1987).
Introduced in New Zealand by Egmont Roses in 1997 as 'Kathryn McGredy'.
rows.Bloom: Salmon-pink. Coral pink. Warm pink. None to mild, opinions vary fragrance. 25 petals. Average diameter 4.5". Large, double (17-25 petals), borne mostly solitary, in small clusters, classic hybrid tea, high-centered, ruffled bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Medium, bushy, compact. Medium, glossy, dark green, dense foliage.

Height: 35" to 4'11" (90 to 150cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 7b and warmer. Can be used for beds and borders, container rose, cut flower, exhibition or garden. Blooms tend to ball in wet weather. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that. Requires spring freeze protection (see glossary - Spring freeze protection) . Can be grown in the ground or in a container (container requires winter protection).
rows.Breeder's notes: Kathryn McGredy - Macauclad. Nicknamed Auckland Lady. For my daughter.
